source: transcribed from web/src/pages/docs/from-pm2.astro, not recorded by the harness
notes: The 2026-09-14 run's metrics.jsonl was never committed, so this seed is the docs page's table converted back to the harness's units. Its precision is the page's: 0.01 MiB, 0.01 us, 1 ms. The next `versus-pm2.sh --record` replaces the whole file with a real run.
The page prints one shep figure per metric and does not say how the two shep rounds were combined, so shep_rounds is absent. A recorded baseline stores their mean and both rounds.
idle_cpu is absent. The page does not say which of the harness's two idle CPU columns it printed, and the metric is reported rather than gated, so a guess here would only mislead a later diff.
The page names an Apple M4 Pro and no OS; the harness is macOS-only, and an M4 Pro is arm64. ncpu and the shep commit were not published.
